title: Theo James dismisses Meghan Markle joining 'The Gentlemen'
summary: Theo James, a star of the Netflix series 'The Gentlemen', stated it would be 'impossible' for Meghan Markle to join the show. The comment came during the world premiere for series 2 of the drama, which took place in London on Wednesday night. James was responding to speculation about Markle's potential involvement in the series.
summary_points: Theo James, star of 'The Gentlemen', said Meghan Markle joining the show would be 'impossible'.
Speculation about Markle's potential involvement in the series was ongoing.
The comments were made at the series 2 premiere in London.
The premiere for the Netflix drama took place on Wednesday night.

summary_hi: नेटफ्लिक्स सीरीज़ 'द जेंटलमैन' के स्टार थियो जेम्स ने कहा कि मेघन मार्कल का शो में शामिल होना 'असंभव' होगा। यह टिप्पणी बुधवार रात लंदन में सीरीज़ 2 के विश्व प्रीमियर के दौरान आई। जेम्स शो में मार्कल की संभावित भागीदारी के बारे में चल रही अटकलों पर प्रतिक्रिया दे रहे थे।

शो में मार्कल की संभावित भागीदारी के बारे में अटकलें चल रही थीं।

center: The coverage from centrist outlets focused on Theo James's direct statement dismissing the possibility of Meghan Markle joining 'The Gentlemen'.
